translations.text: The words of Enoch’s blessing, with which he blessed the chosen and righteous who will be present on the day of distress, when all the evil and wicked are removed.

And Enoch answered and said—a righteous man from God, whose eyes were open and who saw a vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me: “I heard everything from them, and I understood what I saw, not for this generation, but for the distant generations that are to come.”
I spoke about the chosen and took up my discourse concerning them, when the Holy and Great One comes out of his dwelling.
And the God of eternity will go from there onto Mount Sinai. He will appear with his host and reveal himself from heaven in the strength of his power.
Everyone will be afraid, and the Watchers will tremble. Fear and great trembling will seize them, to the ends of the earth.
The high mountains will be shaken, and the lofty hills will be brought low. They will melt like beeswax before a flame.
The earth will be submerged, and everything on the earth will perish. Judgment will come upon everyone, and upon all the righteous.
But he will make peace for the righteous and protect the chosen. Mercy will be upon them, and they will all belong to God. They will prosper and be blessed, and the light of God will shine upon them.

Look, he has come with myriads of holy ones to pass judgment upon them, to destroy the wicked, and to call all flesh to account for everything that sinners and the wicked have done and committed against him.

Examine all the works in heaven: how the heavenly lights do not change their courses, how each rises and sets in its appointed order, each at its own time, and how they do not transgress their command.
Look at the earth and consider the work done upon it, from the beginning to its completion: how none of the works of God that are visible change.
Look at summer and winter: how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds, dew, and rain rest upon it.

Examine—and I saw—how all the trees appear dry, with all their leaves fallen, except fourteen trees whose leaves do not fall. They retain their old leaves until the new ones come, after two or three winters.

Again, examine the days of summer, when the sun is over the earth, facing it. You seek shelter and shade because of the sun’s heat, and the earth grows hot from the scorching heat. You cannot walk on the earth or on the rocks because of their heat.
Examine how the trees clothe themselves in green leaves and bear fruit. Consider everything, how the one who lives forever made all these things for you.
His work takes place before him year after year. All his works obey him and do not change; everything is done just as God has ordained.
See how the seas and rivers together carry out all their work.

But you have not remained steadfast or carried out the Lord’s command. Instead, you have transgressed and spoken great and harsh words with your unclean mouths against his greatness. You hardhearted people will have no peace.
Because of this, you will curse your days and lose the years of your lives. The eternal curse will increase, and you will receive no mercy.
In those days you will give your peace as an eternal curse to all the righteous. Sinners will curse you continually, and for you, together with sinners, [?].
But the chosen will have light, joy, and peace, and they will inherit the earth. But you wicked people will have a curse.
Then wisdom will be given to the chosen, and all of them will live. They will not sin again, either through wickedness or through pride, but those who possess wisdom will be humble.

They will not sin again or be condemned throughout their lives. They will not die in wrath or by a plague, but will complete the full number of the days of their lives. Their lives will grow long in peace, and their years of joy will increase in gladness and eternal peace throughout all the days of their lives.
When human beings multiplied, beautiful and lovely daughters were born to them in those days.

The angels, the sons of heaven, saw them and desired them. They said to one another, “Come, let us choose wives for ourselves from among the daughters of human beings and father children for ourselves.”
And Shemihazah, who was their leader, said to them, “I fear that you may not agree to carry out this deed, and that I alone will have to pay for this great sin.”
They all answered him and said, “Let us all swear an oath and bind one another by a curse not to turn away from this plan, but to carry it out.”
Then they all swore together and bound themselves to one another by a curse concerning it.

They were two hundred in all, and they descended onto Ardis, which is the summit of Mount Hermon. They called the mountain Hermon because they swore there and bound themselves to one another by a curse.

These are the names of their angels: Semyaza, who was their angel; Uraki, Baramiel, Akibiel, Tamiel, Ramuel, Daniel, Ezekiel, Suruquyal, Asael, Armers, Batariel, Ananiel, Zaqebe, Samsapiel, Sartiel, Muriel, Yomiel, and Araziel.
These were the chiefs of the two hundred angels.

And all the others with them took wives for themselves. Each chose one for himself, and they began to go in to them and unite with them. They taught them sorcery and spells and the cutting of roots, and they made them familiar with plants.
The women conceived and gave birth to great giants, each three thousand cubits tall.
These consumed everything that human beings produced through their labor, until human beings could no longer feed them.
Then the giants turned against human beings to devour them.
They began to sin against birds, wild animals, creeping creatures, and fish. They ate one another’s flesh and drank blood from it.
Then she brought an accusation against the lawless ones.

Azazel taught human beings to make swords, knives, shields, and breastplates. He showed them what lay behind them and their workmanship: bracelets, ornaments, the use of eye paint, the beautifying of eyebrows, precious and choice stones of every kind, all kinds of colored dyes, and the transformation of the world.
There was great godlessness. They committed sexual immorality and went astray, and all their ways became corrupt.

Amezarak taught all enchantments and the cutting of roots; Armaros, the undoing of spells; Baraqiel, the observation of stars; and Kokabiel, signs. Tamiel taught the observation of a star, and Asradiel taught the course of the moon.
As people were being destroyed, the people cried out, and their voice reached heaven.
Then Michael, Gabriel, Suriel, and Uriel looked down from heaven and saw the great amount of blood being poured out on the earth and all the wrongdoing being committed on the earth.
They said to one another, “The sound of their cries—the earth has cried out, stripped bare, as far as the gate of heaven.”
“And now, you holy ones of heaven, the souls of human beings bring their complaint to you, saying, ‘Bring our case for judgment before the Most High.’”

They said to their Lord, the King, “For he is Lord of lords, God of gods, and King of kings, and his glorious throne endures through all generations forever. Your name is holy and glorious through all generations forever, blessed and glorious.”
“You made everything, and authority over everything rests with you. Everything is uncovered and revealed before you. You see everything, and nothing can hide from you.”
“You have seen what Azazel has done: how he taught every kind of wrongdoing on the earth and revealed the eternal secrets that are practiced in the heavens.”
And Semjaza taught spells, he to whom you gave authority to rule over those who were together with him.
“Together they went to the daughters of human beings and slept with those women. They defiled themselves and revealed these sins to them.”
“The women gave birth to giants, and through this the whole earth was filled with blood and wrongdoing.”

“And now, look: the souls of those who have died cry out and bring their complaint as far as the gate of heaven. Their cries have risen, and they cannot escape the wrongdoing being committed on the earth.”
“You know everything before it happens. You know this and what concerns them, yet you have told us nothing. What would you like us to do to them about this?”
Then the Most High, the Great and Holy One, spoke and sent Arsialalyur to the son of Lamech.

He said to him, “Tell him in my name, ‘Hide yourself.’ Reveal to him the end that is coming, because the whole earth will be destroyed. A flood of water is about to come upon the whole earth, and everything in it will be destroyed.”
And now teach him how to escape, so that his descendants may remain throughout the earth.
The Lord also said to Raphael, “Bind Azazel by his hands and feet, and put him into darkness. Open up the wilderness that is in Dudael, and put him into darkness there.”
“Put jagged and sharp stones over him, and cover him with darkness. Let him remain there forever, and cover his face so that he cannot see light.”
And on the great day of judgment, he will be sent into the burning fire.

And heal the earth that the angels have ruined, and announce the healing of the earth, so that they may heal it. Heal the earth, so that not all human beings perish through the mystery of all that the Watchers killed [?] and taught their children.
And the whole earth was corrupted through the teaching of Azazel’s works. Attribute all sin to him.

And the Lord said to Gabriel, “Go against the bastards and the rejected ones, and against the children of sexual immorality. Destroy the children of sexual immorality and the children of the Watchers from among human beings. Bring them out and send them against one another, so that they destroy themselves by killing one another, for they will not have long lives.
And they will all petition you, but their fathers will obtain nothing on their behalf, for they hope for eternal life and that each one of them will live five hundred years.”
And the Lord said to Michael, “Go, inform Semjaza and the others with him who united with women, corrupting themselves with them in all their uncleanness.

When all their children have killed one another, and when they have seen the destruction of their loved ones, bind them for seventy generations beneath the hills of the earth, until the day of their judgment and their end, until the judgment that lasts forever is completed.
And in those days they will be taken into the fiery abyss in torment, and they will be confined in prison forever.
And then he will burn and perish, together with them, from now until forever; and they will be bound until the end of all generations.
And destroy all the spirits of the bastards and the children of the Watchers, because they have oppressed human beings.

And destroy all oppression from the face of the earth. Let every evil deed come to an end, and let the plant of righteousness and uprightness appear forever. It will be a blessing; deeds of righteousness and uprightness will be planted in joy forever.
And now all the righteous will escape and remain alive until they father a thousand, and they will complete all the days of their youth and their old age in peace.
And in those days the whole earth will be cultivated in righteousness. It will all be planted with trees and filled with blessing.

And they will plant every delightful tree on it, and they will plant vineyards on it. The vine planted on it will bear fruit in abundance. Of all the seed sown on it, one measure will yield ten thousand, and one measure of olives will yield ten presses of oil.
And you, cleanse the earth of all oppression, all injustice, all sin, all wickedness, and all uncleanness committed on the earth, and remove them completely from the earth.
And all human beings will be righteous, and all nations will worship and bless me, and they will all bow down to me.
And the earth will be cleansed of all corruption, all sin, all punishment, and all suffering. And I will never again send a flood upon it, throughout all generations and forever.
And in those days I will open the storehouses of blessing that are in heaven, to send blessings down upon the earth, upon the work and labor of human beings.
Peace and uprightness will be partners throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of the world.”
Before all these things, Enoch was hidden away, and no human being knew where he had been hidden, where he was, or what had happened to him.
And all his activity during his days was with the holy ones and with the Watchers.
And I, Enoch, was blessing the great Lord and the King of eternity, when the Watchers called me, Enoch the scribe, and said to me:

“Enoch, scribe of righteousness, go and inform the Watchers of heaven who abandoned the high heaven and the holy, eternal dwelling, who corrupted themselves with women, acted as human beings act, took wives for themselves, and brought great corruption upon the earth:
They will have neither peace nor forgiveness of sins upon the earth.

Because they rejoice in their children, they will see their loved ones killed. They will cry out over the destruction of their children and petition forever, but they will have neither mercy nor peace.”
And Enoch went and said to Azazel, “You will have no peace. A great judgment has gone out against you to bind you.”
And you will have no rest, no answer to prayer, and no mercy, because you taught violence and because of all the deeds of blasphemy, violence, and sin that you showed to the children of humankind.
Then I went and told them all together, and they were all afraid; fear and trembling seized them.
And they asked me to write down a record of their petition for them, so that they might receive forgiveness, and to bring the record of their petition up to the Lord of heaven.
For from then on they could not speak or raise their eyes to heaven, because of shame over the sins for which they had been condemned.
Then I wrote down a record of their petition and their plea concerning their spirits and the deeds of each one, and concerning their request for forgiveness and relief.
And I went and sat beside the waters of Dan, in Dan, which is south of the western side of Hermon. I read the record of their petition until I fell asleep.
And behold, a dream came to me, and visions fell upon me. I saw a vision of punishment, which I was to tell to the children of heaven and rebuke them.
When I awoke, I came to them. They were all sitting together, mourning in Abel-shael, which lies between Lebanon and Senir, with their faces covered.
And I told them all the visions that I had seen in my sleep. I began to speak those words of righteousness and to rebuke the Watchers of heaven.
This is the book of the word of righteousness and the rebuke of the eternal Watchers, as the Holy and Great One commanded in that vision.
I saw in my sleep what I now tell with a tongue of flesh and with my spirit. The Great One gave people a mouth to speak with and to understand with their hearts.
Just as he created human beings and gave them the ability to understand words of knowledge, so he also created me and gave me the ability to rebuke the Watchers, the children of heaven.

I wrote down your petition, and in my vision this was shown to me: your petition will not be granted to you throughout all the ages of eternity. A final judgment has gone out against you, and you will have no [?].
From now on you will not ascend into heaven for all eternity. It has been declared that you will be bound within the earth throughout all the ages of eternity.
And before this, you will see the destruction of your beloved children. You will no longer possess them; instead, they will fall before you by the sword.
Your petition for yourselves will not be granted, nor will your petition for them. And you, while weeping and lamenting, will not utter even a single word from the book that I wrote for you.

And a vision like this was shown to me: behold, clouds called me in the vision, and mist called me. The courses of the stars and the lightning urged me onward and pressed me. In the vision the winds made me fly and drove me onward, and they lifted me up to heaven.
And I went until I approached a wall built of hailstones, surrounded by tongues of fire, and it began to frighten me.
And I went into the tongues of fire and approached a great house built of hailstones. The walls of that house were like a pavement of slabs made of hailstones, and its floor was hail.
Its ceiling was like the courses of the stars and the lightning. Among them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was water.
Fire burned around its walls, and its doorway blazed with fire.
I entered that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice. There was no pleasure or life within it. Fear covered me, and trembling seized me.
And as I trembled and shook, I fell on my face and looked in the vision.
And behold, there was another house, greater than this house, with its entire doorway open before me, and it was built of tongues of fire.
In every respect it surpassed the other in splendor, honor, and greatness, so that I cannot tell you of its splendor and greatness.
Its floor was fire, and above it were lightning and the courses of the stars, and its ceiling was burning fire.
And I looked and saw within it a lofty throne. Its appearance was like crystal, and its wheels were like the shining sun, and there was the sound of cherubim.
From beneath the great throne flowed rivers of burning fire, and no one could look at it.
And the Great Glory sat upon it. His clothing shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any hail.
None of the angels can enter and see the face of the glorious and praiseworthy one, and no being of flesh can see him. Fire—
Fire burns around him, and a great fire stands before him. None of those around him approaches him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stand before him, but he does not desire holy counsel.
The holy ones who approach him do not go far away, day or night, and do not depart from him.
Until then I remained on my face, covered and trembling. The Lord called me with his own mouth and said to me, “Come here, Enoch, to my holy word.”
He raised me up and brought me near the doorway, while I kept my face looking downward.
He answered me and said to me with his voice, “Listen, and do not be afraid, Enoch, righteous man and scribe of righteousness. Come here and listen to my word.
Go and tell the Watchers of heaven, for whom you were sent to intercede: ‘You should intercede for human beings, not human beings for you.

Why did you leave the high heaven and the eternal holy dwelling, sleep with women, defile yourselves with the daughters of human beings, take wives for yourselves, act like the children of the earth, and father giant children?

You were spiritual and holy, living an eternal life, but you defiled yourselves with women, fathered children through the blood of flesh, lusted for human blood, and acted like those who are flesh and blood, who die and perish.
For this reason I gave them wives, so that they might sow their seed in them and children might be born through them, so that work might be carried out on the earth.
But you were originally spiritual beings, living an eternal life that does not die through all the generations of the world.
For this reason I did not provide wives for you, because the dwelling of spiritual beings is in heaven.
Now the giants who were born from spirits and flesh will be called evil spirits on the earth, and their dwelling will be on the earth.

Evil spirits came out of their flesh, because they were created from above; their origin and first foundation were from the holy Watchers. They will be evil spirits on the earth, and they will be called evil spirits.
The spirits of heaven will have their dwelling in heaven, and the spirits of the earth, who were born on the earth, will have their dwelling on the earth.
The spirits of the giants are clouds that oppress, destroy, fall, fight, and crush on the earth, and cause sorrow. They find no food to eat, do not thirst, and are not perceived.
These spirits do not rise up against the children of human beings and against women, because they came forth.

In the days of the slaughter, destruction, and death of the giants, when the spirits came out of the souls of their flesh, there will be destruction [?]. They will likewise destroy without judgment until the day of the great judgment, when [?] of the world is completed against the Watchers and the wicked.
And now, to the Watchers who sent you to intercede for them, who formerly lived in heaven:

‘You were in heaven, but the hidden things had not yet been revealed to you. You knew a worthless mystery, and in the hardness of your hearts you told it to women. Through this mystery, women and human beings multiply evil on the earth.’
Tell them, therefore, ‘You have no peace.’”
They took me to a certain place where there were beings like blazing fire, and whenever they wished, they appeared like human beings.
They took me to a place of whirlwind and to a mountain whose summit reached into heaven.
I saw four bright places and thunder at the farthest edges, and in the depths a bow of fire, arrows and their quivers, a sword of fire, and all the lightning.
They took me to the water of life, which speaks, and to the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun.
I came to a river of fire whose fire flows like water and pours into the great sea toward the west.
I saw all the great rivers and reached the great darkness, and I went to where all beings of flesh wander.
I saw the mountains of winter darkness and the outpouring of water from the whole deep.
And I saw the mouths of all the rivers of the earth and the mouth of the deep.
And I saw the storehouses of all the winds, and I saw how he used them to arrange all creation and the foundations of the earth.
And I saw the cornerstone of the earth, and I saw the four winds that support the earth and the vault of heaven.
And I saw how the winds stretch out the height of heaven. They stand between heaven and earth, and they are the pillars of heaven.
And I saw the winds that turn the heavens and make the disk of the sun and all the stars set.
And I saw the winds above the earth that carry the clouds, and I saw the paths of the angels. And at the edge of the earth I saw the vault of heaven above.
And I went toward the south, where there was burning day and night, to the seven mountains of precious stone: three toward the east and three toward the south.
The one toward the east was of colored stone, and one was of stone of the sea, and another was of healing stone; the one toward the south was of red stone.
The middle one reached up to heaven like the throne of God, made of alabaster, and the top of his throne was of sapphire.
And I saw burning fire, which was in all the mountains.
And there I saw a place beyond the great earth; there the waters gather.
And I saw a deep chasm in the earth, with pillars of heavenly fire. And among them I saw fiery pillars of heaven descending, without number either above or below.
And above that chasm I saw a place with no vault of heaven above it and no foundation of earth beneath it. There was no water over it and no birds, but it was a desolate place.
And there I saw a terrifying sight: seven stars like great burning mountains, and like a spirit questioning me.
The angel said, "This is the place where heaven and earth end. This has become a prison for the stars of heaven and the host of heaven."
And the stars that roll about over the fire are those that transgressed God's command before their rising, because they did not come at their appointed time.
And he was angry with them and bound them until the time when their sin would be completed, in the year of mystery.

And Uriel said to me, "Here will stand the spirits of the angels who joined with women. Taking many forms, they have defiled human beings and lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods. For on the great day of judgment they will be judged until they are destroyed."
And their wives, who led the angels astray, will become sirens.
And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision of the ends of everything, and no human being has seen what I saw.
And these are the names of the holy angels who keep watch.
Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is in charge of thunder and trembling.
Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is in charge of the spirits of human beings.
Raguel, one of the holy angels, who takes vengeance on the world and the lights.
Michael, one of the holy angels, who is appointed over the best part of humanity and over the people.
Saraqael, one of the holy angels, who is in charge of the spirits of human beings who sin in spirit.
Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is in charge of the serpents, Paradise, and the cherubim.
And there I saw a terrifying sight: neither heaven above nor earth firmly founded, but a desolate place, prepared and terrifying.
And there I saw seven stars of heaven bound together above it, like great mountains, burning like fire.
Then I said, “For what sin have they been bound, and why have they been left here?”
And Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me, “Enoch, why do you ask, and about whom do you inquire and laugh?”
These are the angels who transgressed the command of the Most High God and were bound here until ten thousand years are completed, the number of days of their sin.

And from there I went to another place, more terrifying than this one. And I saw a terrifying sight: a great fire there, burning and blazing. There was a fissure in it, whose extent reached down to the uttermost abyss, with great pillars of fire being sent down into it. I could see neither its extent nor its size, and I could not make out its appearance.
Then I said, “How terrifying this place is, and how painful to look at!”
Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said to me, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and alarmed because of this terrifying place and at the sight of this suffering?”
And he said to me, “This place is the prison of the angels, and there they will be held forever.”
And from there I went to another place, and he showed me in the west a great, tall mountain of solid rock.
And inside it were four beautiful places, deep and wide and very smooth, as smooth as something rolling, and deep and dark to look at.

Then Raphael, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said to me, “These beautiful places were created for the spirits of the dead to gather in them. Here they will gather the souls of human beings.
“These places were made to hold them until the day of their judgment and until their appointed time. That time is long, until the great judgment comes upon them.”
And I saw the spirits of human beings who were dead, and their voice reached heaven and brought an accusation.
Then I asked Raphael, the angel who was with me, and said to him, “Whose spirit is this, whose voice reaches heaven in this way and brings an accusation?”

And he answered me, saying, “This is the spirit that came out of Abel, whom his brother Cain killed. It accuses him until his descendants are destroyed from the face of the earth and his descendants perish from among the descendants of humankind.”
Then I asked him about this and about the judgment of all, and I said, “Why is one separated from another?”

And he answered me and said to me, “These three were made to separate the spirits of the dead. And in this way the souls of the righteous have been separated: this is the spring of water over which there is light.
“Likewise, a place was created for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth, and judgment has not come upon them during their lives.

“Here their souls will be separated for this great suffering until the great day of judgment, punishment, and suffering for those who curse forever, and vengeance upon their souls. There he will bind them forever, even though this has been so from before eternity.
“And in this way a separate place has been set apart for the souls of those who bring accusations, who bear witness about their destruction when they were killed in the days of sinners.

“And in this way places were created for the souls of wicked people who were not righteous but sinners, complete in wrongdoing. They will be with the wrongdoers, like them. Yet their souls will not be killed on the day of judgment, nor will they rise from here.”
Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said, “Blessed is my Lord, the Lord of glory and righteousness, who rules over everything forever.”
From there I saw another place toward the west, extending to the ends of the earth.
And I saw a fire burning and running without resting or stopping its course, day or night, but continuing in the same way [?].
And I asked, saying, “What is this that has no rest?”
Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “This course that you saw toward the west is the fire that burns all the lights of heaven.”
From there I went to another place on the earth, and he showed me a mountain of fire that blazed day and night.

And I went toward it and saw seven splendid mountains, each different from the other, and precious and beautiful stones. All were splendid and glorious in appearance, and their surfaces were beautiful. Three were toward the east, firmly set one upon another, and three toward the north, firmly set one upon another. There were deep, winding valleys, none of which came close to another.
And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and all their heights resembled the throne of [?], and fragrant trees surrounded it.

Among them was a tree whose fragrance was without limit when I smelled it. None of the trees among them, nor any others, was like it; its fragrance surpassed every fragrance. Its leaves, its blossoms, and its wood never wither, and its fruit is beautiful. Its fruit is like a cluster of dates.
Then I said, “Look at this beautiful tree, beautiful to behold! Its leaves are lovely, and its fruit is very glorious to look upon.”
Then Michael, one of the holy and honored angels who was with me and was in charge of them, answered me.
And he said to me, “Enoch, why do you ask about the fragrance of this tree and inquire so that you may know?”
Then I, Enoch, answered him, saying, “I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.”

And he answered me, saying, “This lofty mountain that you saw, whose summit resembles the Lord’s throne, is his throne, where the Holy and Great One, the Lord of Glory, the eternal King, will sit when he comes down to visit the earth with goodness.

“As for this beautifully fragrant tree, no mortal has authority to touch it until the great judgment, when everything will be avenged and brought to completion forever. It will be given to the righteous and the humble.
“From its fruit life will be given to the chosen. It will be planted toward the north, in the holy place, beside the house of the Lord, the eternal King.

“Then they will rejoice with joy and be glad in the holy place. They will take its fragrance into every one of their bones, and they will live a long life upon the earth, as your ancestors lived. In their days, sorrow, sickness, toil, and affliction will not touch them.”
Then I blessed the Lord of Glory, the eternal King, because he had prepared such things for righteous people, had created such things, and had said that he would give them to them.
From there I went to the middle of the earth and saw a blessed, well-watered place where shoots remained and sprouted from a tree that had been cut down.
There I saw a holy mountain, and beneath the mountain, on its eastern side, there was water flowing toward the north.
To the east I saw another mountain, higher than this one. Between them was a deep, narrow valley, and through it water flowed beside the mountain.
To the west of this was another mountain, lower than it and not high. Below it was a valley between them, and there were other deep, dry valleys at the extremities of the three mountains.
All its valleys were deep and narrow, formed of hard rock, and trees were planted upon them.
I marveled at the rocks and marveled at the valleys; I marveled greatly.
Then I said, “Why is this land blessed and entirely filled with trees, while this valley in their midst is cursed?”

Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “This valley is cursed for those who are cursed forever. Here all those who speak improper words against the Lord with their mouths and say outrageous things about his glory will be gathered. Here they will gather them, and here will be their judgment.”

In the last days there will be upon them a demonstration of righteous judgment before the righteous forever. Here, throughout all days, those who have received mercy will bless the Lord of Glory, the eternal King.
In the days of their judgment, they will bless him for his mercy, according to what he has allotted to them.
Then I too blessed the Lord of Glory, spoke to him, and commemorated him as befitted his greatness.
From there I went eastward, into the midst of the mountain wilderness. I saw the wilderness alone, and it alone was full of trees.
From this seed [?], and water gushed down upon it. Above it appeared streams, like abundant water flowing toward the northwest. It rose from every side, and from there came water and dew.
I went into another place in the wilderness and approached the eastern side of that mountain.
There I saw trees of judgment, very fragrant incense, frankincense and myrrh; and the trees were not alike.
Above it, above these, upon the eastern mountain and not far away, I saw another place: valleys of water that seemed inexhaustible.
And I saw a beautiful tree, and its fragrance was like that of mastic.
Along the sides of these valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon, and I approached beyond these toward the east.
And I saw another mountain with trees on it, and water flowed from it like nectar, called storax and galbanum.
And above that mountain I saw another mountain with aloe trees on it. Those trees were full of fruit like hard almonds.
And when they take that fruit, it is better than all other spices.
And beyond these spices, toward the north, as I looked over the mountains, I saw seven mountains full of choice spikenard, fragrant trees, cinnamon, and pepper.
And from there I went over the summits of those mountains, far toward the east. I crossed over the Red Sea and went far from it, and I passed above the angel Zotiel.

And I came into the garden of righteousness and saw there [?] those trees: many large trees growing there, with a pleasant fragrance, great size, and abundant beauty, and splendid. And there was the tree of wisdom, from which those who eat come to know great wisdom.
And it resembles a carob tree, and its fruit is like a very beautiful cluster of grapes. The fragrance of that tree spreads and reaches far.
And I said, “This tree is beautiful! How beautiful and delightful it is to look at!”

And the holy angel Raphael, who was with me, answered me and said, “This is the tree of wisdom from which your ancient father and your aged mother, who came before you, ate. They came to know wisdom, and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked, and they were driven out of the garden.”

And from there I went to the ends of the earth, and there I saw great wild animals, each different from the other. The birds also differed in their appearance and beauty, and their voices differed from one another.
And to the east of these beasts I saw the ends of the earth, where heaven rests, and open gates.

And I saw how the stars of heaven come out, and I counted the gates through which they come out. I wrote down all their exits, each one separately, according to their numbers and names, their ranks and positions, their times and months, as the angel Uriel, who was with me, showed me.
And he showed me everything and wrote it down. He also wrote down for me their names, their orders, and their activities.
And from there I went northward to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious wonder at the ends of the whole earth.
And there I saw three gates of heaven standing open in heaven. Winds come out through each of them, and toward the north, when they blow, there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.
And from one gate they blow favorably, but when they blow through the other two gates, it brings violence and hardship upon the earth, and they blow violently.

And from there I went toward the west, to the ends of the earth, and there I saw three gates of heaven standing open, like those I had seen in the east, with the same number of gates and the same number of exits.
And from there I went toward the south, to the ends of the earth, and there I saw three gates of heaven standing open. From there come the south wind, dew, rain, and wind.
And from there I went toward the east, to the ends of heaven, and there I saw three gates of heaven standing open toward the east, and above them were small gates.
Through each of these small gates the stars of heaven pass, and they travel westward along the path shown to them.

And when I saw this, I blessed the Lord of Glory, and at all times I bless him, who performed great and glorious wonders to show the greatness of his work to his angels and to human souls, so that they might praise his work and all his deeds, so that they might see the work of his power, praise the great work of his hands, and bless him forever.
The vision that he saw: the second vision, a vision of wisdom, which Enoch saw, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam.

And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom that I began to speak and declare to those who dwell on the dry land: “Listen, you who came before, and see, you who come afterward, the holy words that I speak before the Lord of Spirits.”
It is better to speak of these earlier things, but we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom from those who come later.

And until now, no wisdom such as the wisdom I received has been given to me from before the Lord of Spirits, according to my understanding and according to the will of the Lord of Spirits, from whom a share in eternal life has been given to me.
And three parables came to me, and I will declare them to those who dwell on the dry land.
The first parable. When the congregation of the righteous appears, and sinners are judged for their sins and driven from the face of the dry land;

And when the Righteous One appears before the righteous, whose chosen deeds depend on the Lord of Spirits, and light appears for the righteous and the chosen who dwell on the dry land, where will the dwelling of sinners be, and where will the resting place be for those who have denied the Lord of Spirits? It would have been better for them if they had not been born.
And when the hidden things of the righteous are revealed, sinners will be condemned, and the wicked will be troubled in the presence of the righteous and the chosen.

From now on, those who possess the earth will no longer be powerful or exalted, and they will not be able to look at the faces of the holy ones, because the light of the Lord of Spirits has appeared on the faces of the holy, righteous, and chosen ones.
At that time the mighty kings will perish and be handed over into the hands of the righteous and the holy.
From then on, no one will plead for mercy for them before the Lord of Glory, because their life has come to an end.
In those days, the children of the chosen and holy ones will descend from the highest heavens, and their offspring will become one with the children of humanity.
In those days Enoch received books of jealousy and wrath, and books of destruction and turmoil. And there will be no mercy for them, says the Lord of Spirits.
At that time a cloud and a whirlwind carried me away from the face of the earth and set me at the edge of the heavens.
There I saw another vision: the dwellings of the righteous and the resting places of the holy.

There my eyes saw their dwellings with the angels and their resting places with the holy ones. They petitioned, pleaded, and prayed for the children of humanity. Righteousness flowed like water before them, and mercy like dew upon the earth. So it is among them forever and ever.

In those days my eyes saw the place of the chosen ones of righteousness and faith. Righteousness will prevail in their days, and the righteous and chosen ones will be beyond number before him forever and ever.

I saw their dwelling beneath the wings of the Lord of Spirits. All the righteous and chosen ones shone before him like the light of fire. Their mouths were filled with blessing, and their lips praised the name of the Lord of Spirits. Righteousness will never cease before him, and uprightness will never cease before him.
There I wished to dwell, and my soul desired that dwelling. My portion had already been there, for this had been established for me before the Lord of Spirits.

In those days I praised and exalted the name of the Lord of Spirits. I offered blessing and praise, because he had strengthened me with blessing and praise, according to the will of the Lord of Spirits.
And [?] my eyes looked at that place, and I blessed him and praised him, saying, “He is blessed, and may he be blessed from before the beginning of the world and forever.”
And before him there is no end. Before the world was created, he knows what the world is and what will happen from generation to generation.
“Those who do not sleep bless you. They stand before your glory and bless, praise, and exalt you, saying, ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Spirits, and he fills the earth with spirits.’”
There my eyes saw all those who do not sleep standing before him. They blessed him and said, “Blessed are you, and blessed is the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.”
My face changed, because I could not look at him.
After this I saw thousands upon thousands and tens of thousands upon thousands. Those who stood before the Lord of Spirits could neither be numbered nor counted.

On the four sides of the Lord of Spirits I saw four figures, different from those who stood there. I learned their names, which the angel who came with me made known to me; he showed me all the hidden things.
And I heard the voices of those four faces as they praised the Lord of Spirits.
The first voice blessed the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.
And I heard the second voice blessing the Chosen One and the chosen ones who depend on the Lord of Spirits.
I heard the third voice offering petitions and praying for those who dwell on dry land, and pleading in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
I heard the fourth voice driving away the satans and not allowing them to come before the Lord of Spirits to accuse those who dwell on dry land.
After this I asked the angel of peace who walked with me and showed me everything hidden. I said to him, “Who are these four figures whom I saw, whose voices I heard and wrote down?”

And he said to me, “This first voice is the merciful and patient holy Michael. The second, who is over every illness and every wound of humanity, is Raphael. The third, who is over every power, is holy Gabriel. And the fourth, who is over repentance and the hope of those who inherit eternal life, is Phanuel.”
These are the four angels of God Most High, and I heard four voices in those days.
And after this I saw all the secrets of the heavens, how the kingdom is divided, and how human deeds are weighed in a balance.

There I saw the dwellings of the holy ones and the dwelling of the chosen ones. There my eyes saw all the sinners who deny the name of the Lord of Spirits being driven away from that place. They were dragged away, and they could not stand against the punishment that comes from the Lord of Spirits.

There my eyes saw the secrets of lightning and thunder, the secrets of the winds and how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew. There I saw where they come out in that place, and how from there they saturate the dust of the earth.

There I saw closed storehouses from which the winds are distributed, the storehouse of hail, the storehouse of mist, and the storehouse of clouds. Its cloud has remained above the earth since before the world began.

I saw the storehouses of the sun and the moon, where they come out and where they enter, their glorious return, and how one is more honored than the other. Their course is magnificent. They do not go beyond their course, neither lengthening nor shortening it, and they keep faith with one another according to the oath they have sworn.
The sun goes out first and follows its path at the command of the Lord of Spirits, and his name stands firm forever and ever.

After this I saw the moon’s hidden and visible path, and how it completes the course of its path in that place by day and by night. Each watches the other before the Lord of Spirits. They give thanks and praise without resting, for their thanksgiving is their rest.

For the bright sun undergoes many changes, bringing blessing and curse, and the moon’s journey along its path brings light to the righteous and darkness to sinners, in the name of the Lord of Spirits. He made a division between light and darkness, apportioned the spirits of human beings, and strengthened the spirits of the righteous in the name of his righteousness.
For no angel can prevent it, and no power can restrain it, because the Judge sees them all, and he judges all these things before him.
Wisdom found no place where she could dwell, and her dwelling was in the heavens.
And Wisdom went out to dwell among human beings, but she found no dwelling place. Wisdom returned to her place and settled among the angels.
Unrighteousness came out of her storehouses. She found those whom she had not sought and dwelt among them, like rain in the wilderness and like dew on thirsty ground.
I saw other flashes of lightning and the stars of heaven. I saw how he calls them all by their names, and they listen to him.

I saw the righteous balance, how they are weighed according to their brightness, the extent of their places, and the day of their appearance. I saw their revolutions: lightning gives birth to lightning. Their revolutions follow the number of their angels, and they keep faith with one another.
I asked the angel who was walking with me and showing me the hidden things, and I said to him, “What are these?”
He said to me, “The Lord of Spirits has shown you what they represent. These are the names of the righteous who dwell on the dry land and believe in the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.”
I saw other things concerning lightning: how some arise from the stars and become lightning, and cannot abandon their form.
This is another parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and of the Lord of Spirits.
They will not ascend to heaven or reach the earth. Such will be the lot of the sinners who deny the name of the Lord of Spirits, who are thus kept for the day of suffering and distress.

On that day the Chosen One will sit on the throne of glory and examine their deeds and their resting places, which are beyond number. Their spirits will grow strong within them when they see my Chosen One and those who call upon my holy and glorious name.
On that day I will seat him among them, and I will transform heaven and make it a blessing and an everlasting light.
And I will transform the dry land and make it a blessing, and I will settle my chosen ones within it. But those who commit sin and wrongdoing will not walk within it.
For I have seen my righteous ones, satisfied them with peace, and seated them before me. My judgment of sinners has drawn near to me, to destroy them from the face of the earth.

There I saw the Head of Days, whose head was like white wool. With him was another whose face had the appearance of a human being. He was full of grace, and his face was like that of one of the holy angels.

I asked one of the holy angels who was walking with me and showing me all the hidden things about that Son of Man. I said to him, “Who is he? Where does he come from? Why does he walk with the Head of Days?”

He answered me and said, “This is the Son of Man to whom righteousness belongs, and with whom righteousness dwells. He reveals all the storehouses of hidden things, because the Lord of Spirits has chosen him, and his portion surpasses all others before the Lord of Spirits in righteousness forever.
“This Son of Man whom you have seen will raise kings and the mighty from their beds, and the powerful from their thrones. He will loosen the reins of the powerful and crush the teeth of sinners.
“He will drive kings from their thrones and from their kingdoms, because they do not exalt him or praise him, or give thanks for the source from which their kingdom was given to them.

“He will strike down the faces of the powerful and fill them with shame. Darkness will be their dwelling, and worms will be their beds. They will have no hope of rising from their beds, because they do not exalt the name of the Lord of Spirits.”

And they became those who judge the stars of heaven and raise their hands against the Most High. They walk on dry land and live on it, and all their deeds display injustice, and all their deeds are injustice. Their power rests on their wealth, and their faith is in the gods they made with their own hands. They deny the name of the Lord of Spirits.
And they drive his congregation from their houses, along with the faithful who depend on the name of the Lord of Spirits.
And in those days the prayer of the righteous rose up, and the blood of the righteous was called to account before the Lord of Spirits.

And in those days the holy ones who dwell above the heavens will unite, and with one voice they will plead, pray, praise, give thanks, and bless the name of the Lord of Spirits because of the blood of the righteous that has been shed. They will ask that the prayer of the righteous not be rejected before the Lord of Spirits, that judgment be carried out for them, and that patience toward their oppressors not last forever.
And in those days I saw the Head of Days as he sat on the throne of his glory. The books of the living were opened before him, and his entire host above the heavens stood around him, in his presence.

And joy will fill the hearts of the holy ones, because the full measure of righteousness has been reached, the prayer of the righteous has been heard, and the blood of the righteous has been taken into account before the Lord of Spirits.

And in that place I saw a spring of righteousness that never runs dry. Around it were many springs of wisdom. All the thirsty drink from it and are filled with wisdom, and their dwellings are with the righteous, the holy, and the chosen.
And at that hour that Son of Man was named in the presence of the Lord of Spirits, and his name was named before the Head of Days.
And before the sun and the signs were created, and before the stars of heaven were made, his name was called before the Lord of Spirits.
And he will be a staff for the righteous and the holy, so that they may lean on him and not fall. He will be the light of the nations, and he will be the hope of those whose hearts are troubled.
And all who dwell on dry land will fall down and bow before him. They will bless him, praise him, and sing to him, to the name of the Lord of Spirits.
And for this reason he was chosen and hidden before him before the world was created.

And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits revealed him to the righteous and the chosen, for he preserved the portion of the righteous. For they hated and rejected this world of injustice, and they hated all its works and ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits. For in his name they are saved, and he became the avenger of their lives.

And in those days the kings of the earth and the mighty who possess the dry land will hang their heads because of the work of their hands, for on the day of their distress and trouble they will not save themselves.

And I will place them in the hands of my chosen ones, like grass in fire and like lead in water. In this way they will burn before the righteous and sink before the holy, and no trace of them will be found.

And on the day of their trouble, fear will come upon the earth. They will fall before him and will not rise, and there will be no one to take them by the hand and lift them up, because they denied the Lord of Spirits and his Anointed One. And blessed be the name of the Lord of Spirits.
For wisdom is poured out like water, and glory never ceases before him, forever and ever.

For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, and injustice passes away like a shadow and has no firm footing, because the Chosen One stands before the Lord of Spirits. His glory is forever and ever, and his power is from generation to generation.
And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, the spirit that gives understanding, the spirit of instruction and power, and the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
And he will judge hidden things, and no one will be able to speak a false word before him, because he is chosen before the Lord of Spirits according to his will.
And in those days a change will take place for the holy and the chosen. The light of days will dwell upon them, and glory and honor will return to the holy.

And on the day of trouble, disaster will be stored up for sinners, and the righteous will prevail in the name of the Lord of Spirits. He will show the others that they should repent and abandon the work of their hands.
And they will have honor before the Lord of Spirits, and in his name they will be saved. The Lord of Spirits will have mercy on them, because his mercy is great.
And he is righteous in his judgment and in the presence of his glory. Injustice will not stand at his judgment, and whoever does not repent before him will perish.
“But from now on he will not have mercy on them,” said the Lord of Spirits.
And in those days the earth will return what it holds in its womb, and Sheol will return what was entrusted to its womb, and destruction will return what it owes.
And he will choose the righteous and the holy from among them, because the day has drawn near for them to be saved.

And in those days the Chosen One will sit on his throne, and he will bring forth all the thoughts of wisdom from the deliberation of his mouth, because the Lord of Spirits has given this to him and glorified him.
And in those days the mountains will dance like rams and leap like lambs full of milk, and they will all become angels in heaven.
And their faces will shine with joy, because in those days the Chosen One will arise. The earth will rejoice, the righteous will dwell upon it, and the chosen will walk and move about within it.
And after those days, in that place where I saw all the secret visions, I was carried away in a whirlwind, and they took me to the west.

And there my eyes saw the secrets of heaven, all that is to happen on the earth: a mountain of iron, a mountain of copper, a mountain of silver, a mountain of gold, a mountain of tin, and a mountain of lead.
I asked the angel who was walking with me, saying, “What are these things that I have seen in secret?”
He said to me, “All these things that you have seen will serve the authority of his Messiah, so that he may command and exercise power over the earth.”
That angel of peace answered me, saying, “Wait a little, and you will see; everything hidden that the Lord of Spirits has planted will be revealed to you.”

And these mountains that you saw—the mountain of iron, the mountain of copper, the mountain of silver, the mountain of gold, the mountain of tin, and the mountain of lead—will all be like wax before a fire in the presence of the Chosen One, and like water flowing down from above upon those mountains. And they will become powerless beneath his feet.
In those days they will not be saved by gold or by silver, and they will not be able to escape or flee.
There will be no iron for warfare, nor clothing for armor to protect the back. Bronze will be of no use, and tin will be of no use and will not be valued; lead will not be wanted.
Instead, they will all be swept away, and their existence will be destroyed from the face of the earth when the Chosen One appears before the Lord of Spirits.

There my eyes saw a deep valley with its mouth open. All those who live on dry land, on the sea, and on the islands will bring him gifts, offerings, and tribute, but that deep valley will not be filled.

They commit wrongdoing with their hands, and sinners consume everything for which they toil in wrongdoing. The sinners will be destroyed from the presence of the Lord of Spirits and driven away from the face of his earth, and they will not come to an end forever and ever.
For I saw the angels of punishment going about and preparing all the instruments for Satan.
I asked the angel of peace who was walking with me, saying to him, “For whom are they preparing these instruments?”
He said to me, “They are preparing these for the kings and the powerful of this earth, so that they may be destroyed with them.”
After this, the Righteous and Chosen One will reveal the house of his congregation. From then on, they will no longer be hindered in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
These mountains will become like earth before him, and the hills will become like a spring of water. The righteous will rest from the oppression of sinners.
I turned and saw another part of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley in which fire was burning.
They brought the kings and the powerful and threw them into that deep valley.
There my eyes saw their instruments being made into iron chains of immeasurable weight.
I asked the angel of peace who was walking with me, saying, “For whom are these instruments of chains being prepared?”

He said to me, “These are being prepared for the hosts of Azazel, so that they may be handed over and cast down under full condemnation. Rough stones will cover their jaws, as the Lord of Spirits has commanded.”

Michael, Gabriel, Raphael, and Phanuel will seize them on that great day and throw them into the furnace of blazing fire on that day, so that the Lord of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their wrongdoing, because they became servants of Satan and led astray those who live on dry land.
In those days the punishment of the Lord of Spirits will go forth, and all the storehouses of the waters above the heavens and of the springs beneath the heavens and above the earth will be opened.
All the waters will unite with the waters above the heavens. The water above the heavens is male, and the water beneath the earth is female.
They will wipe out all those who live on dry land and those who live beneath the ends of heaven.
And because of this they recognized the injustice they committed on the earth, and because of this they will perish.
After this, the Head of Days regretted it and said, “In vain have I destroyed all those who live on dry land.”

He swore by his great name that from then on he would not do this to all those who live on dry land: “I will place a sign in heaven, and it will be a pledge of faithfulness between me and them forever, for as long as heaven remains above the earth.”

“After this, it will be at my command: when I wish to seize them through the angels on the day of distress and suffering, my wrath and punishment will rest upon them beforehand,” says God, the Lord of Spirits.
You mighty kings who dwell on the earth will see my Chosen One when he sits on the throne of his glory and judges Azazel, all his company, and all his hosts in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
And there I saw hosts of angels of punishment going along, holding chains of iron and bronze.
And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying, “For whom are these who hold them going?”
And he said to me, “Each one is going for their chosen ones and their beloved ones, so that they may be thrown into the clefts of the deep valley.”
Then that valley will be filled with their chosen ones and their beloved ones. The days of their lives will come to an end, and from then on the days of their wandering will no longer be counted.

In those days the angels will gather and turn their heads toward the east, toward the people of Parthia and Media. They will stir up the kings, and a spirit of turmoil will come upon them and drive them from their thrones. They will come out like lions from their lairs and like hungry wolves among their pastures.
They will march up and trample the land of his chosen ones, and the land of his chosen ones will become a place to be trampled and a beaten path before them.

The city of my righteous ones will become an obstacle to their horses. They will begin slaughtering one another, and their right hands will turn fiercely against one another. A man will not recognize his fellow or his brother, nor a son his father or his mother, until the number of their corpses is complete through their death and their punishment. And it will not be in vain.
And in those days Sheol will open its mouth, and they will sink into it. And Sheol will swallow the sinners, destroying them, from before the chosen ones.
After this, I saw another host of chariots with people riding in them. They came on the winds from the east and from the west until midday.

The sound of their chariots was heard. When this turmoil arose, the holy ones in heaven became aware of it, and the pillar of the earth was shaken from its place. It was heard from one end of heaven to the other in a single day.
And they will all fall down and worship the Lord of Spirits. And this is the end of the second parable.
And I began to tell the third parable, concerning the righteous and the chosen.
Blessed are you, the righteous and the chosen, for your allotted portion is glorious.
The righteous will be in the light of the sun, and the chosen in the light of eternal life. The days of their lives will have no end, and the days of the holy ones will have no number.
They will seek the light and find righteousness with the Lord of Spirits, and there will be peace for the righteous with the Lord of the world.
After this, the holy ones in heaven will be told to seek the secrets of righteousness, the allotted portion of faith, for it has risen like the sun over the earth, and darkness has passed away.

There will be light that cannot be counted, and they will not enter into a count of days, for the former darkness has been destroyed. Light will endure before the Lord of Spirits, and the light of uprightness will endure forever before the Lord of Spirits.
In those days my eyes saw the secrets of the lightning flashes and the lights, and their judgment. They flash for blessing and for curse, as the Lord of Spirits wills.

There I saw the secrets of the thunder. When it crashes in the heights of heaven, its sound is heard. He showed me the dwelling places of the earth, and the sound of the thunder for peace and blessing, or for a curse, at the word of the Lord of Spirits.
After this, all their secrets were shown to me: the lights and the lightning flashes shine for blessing and abundance.

In the five hundredth year of Enoch’s life, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month, in that vision I saw the heaven of heavens shaking with a great shaking. The host of the Most High and the angels, myriads upon myriads and tens of thousands upon tens of thousands, were thrown into great turmoil.
Then I saw the Head of Days sitting on the throne of his glory, with the angels and the righteous standing around him.
A great trembling seized me, and fear took hold of me. My hips gave way and loosened, my kidneys melted, and I fell on my face.

Holy Michael sent another holy angel, one of the holy angels, and he raised me up. When he raised me up, my spirit returned, for I had been unable to endure the sight of that host, that turmoil, and the shaking of heaven.
Holy Michael said to me, “Why are you disturbed by a vision like this? Until today the day of his mercy has lasted, and he has been merciful and slow to anger toward those who dwell on the earth.

But when the day of power, punishment, and judgment comes—the day that the Lord of Spirits has prepared for those who bow before the judgment of righteousness, for those who deny the judgment of righteousness, and for those who take his name in vain—that day has been prepared as a covenant for the chosen and an inquiry for sinners.”
On that day the two monsters will be separated. The female monster, whose name is Leviathan, will dwell in the depths of the sea, above the springs of water.

The male is named Behemoth. He occupies with his back an unseen wilderness named Dendain, east of the garden where the righteous and the chosen dwell, where my grandfather was received. He was the seventh from Adam, the first of the human beings whom the Lord of Spirits made.
I asked that other angel to show me the power of these monsters, how they were separated on a single day and placed, one in the depths of the sea and the other on the dry land of the wilderness.
He said to me, “You, son of man, wish to know what is hidden here.”

The other angel who was walking with me spoke to me, showing me the hidden things, the first and the last, in heaven above, within the earth in the depths, at the ends of heaven, and at the foundation of heaven.

He also showed me the storehouses of the winds: how the spirits are divided, how they are weighed, and how the springs and winds are counted by the power of the spirit; the power of the moon’s light, and how the power of righteousness [?]; and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how every division is divided.
He showed me the thunder in the places where it falls and every division into which it is divided; the lightning, how it flashes; and their companies, how they obey swiftly.
For thunder has resting places, and patience has been given to its sound. Neither thunder nor lightning is separated from the other. Both travel by the spirit and are not separated.

For when the lightning flashes, thunder gives its sound, and the spirit rests at its proper time and divides equally between them. For the storehouse of their times is of sand. Each of them is held with a bridle at its proper time, and they are turned back by the power of the spirit and driven in this way throughout the many regions of the earth.
The spirit of the sea is male. According to the strength of the sea’s power, he restrains it with a bridle, and in this way it is driven and scattered over all the mountains of the earth.
The spirit of hoarfrost is its own angel, and the spirit of hail is a good angel.
The angel of snow has left it because of its wickedness. It has a spirit of its own, and what rises from it is like smoke, and its name is frost.

The spirit of mist does not join them in their storehouses but has a storehouse of its own. For its course is in glory, in light and darkness, in winter and summer. Its storehouse is light, and it is its own angel.

And the spirit of dew has its dwelling at the ends of heaven, and it is connected with the storehouses of rain. Its course is in winter and summer, and its cloud and the cloud of mist are joined together, and one gives to the other.

When the spirit of rain moves from its storehouse, angels come, open the storehouse, and bring it out. When it is scattered over all the dry land, it joins all the water on the dry land; and whenever it joins the water on the dry land,
the waters are for those who dwell on the dry land. For the nourishment of the dry land comes from the Most High who is in heaven. For this reason rain has a measure, and the angels attend to it.
I saw all these things as far as the garden of the righteous.

The angel of peace who was with me said to me, “These two monsters, prepared for the greatness of God, will be fed when the punishment of God [?], and little children will be killed with their mothers, and children with their fathers.”

“When the punishment of the Lord of Spirits rests upon them, so that the punishment of the Lord of Spirits does not come [?] upon these, afterward there will be judgment in his mercy and his patience.”
In those days I saw long cords given to those angels. They took wings for themselves, flew, and went toward the north.
I asked the angel, saying, “Why have these taken long cords and gone away?”
The angel who was walking with me said to me, “They are bringing them to measure the measurements of the righteous, so that they may lean upon the name of the Lord of Spirits forever and ever.”
“They will begin, and the chosen will dwell with the chosen. These are the measurements that will be given to faith and will strengthen the word of righteousness.”

And these measurements will reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, so that those who perished in the wilderness and those who were devoured by the fish of the sea and by wild beasts may return and stand firm on the day of the Chosen One. For no one perishes before the Lord of Spirits, and no one can perish.
All those above the heavens received a command, and power, and one voice, and one light like fire.
They bless him with their first words, exalt him, and praise him with wisdom. They are wise in speech and in the spirit of life.
The Lord of Spirits seated the Chosen One on the throne of his glory. He will judge all the works of the holy ones above the heavens, and all their deeds will be weighed in the balance.

When he lifts his face to judge their hidden ways by the word of the name of the Lord of Spirits, and their tracks along the path of the righteous judgment of God Most High, they will all speak with one voice and bless, praise, exalt, and glorify the name of the Lord of Spirits.

He will summon all the hosts of heaven, all the holy ones above, and the hosts of God—the cherubim, seraphim, and ophanim—all the angels of power, all the angels of dominion, the Chosen One, and the other powers on dry land and over the water.

On that day they will raise one voice and bless, praise, glorify, and exalt with a spirit of faith, a spirit of wisdom, patience, a spirit of mercy, a spirit of judgment and peace, and a spirit of goodness. They will all say with one voice, “Blessed is the name of the Lord of Spirits, and may it be blessed forever and ever.”

All the holy ones who do not sleep in the highest heaven will bless him, as will all the chosen ones who dwell in the garden of life, and every spirit of light that can bless, praise, exalt, and sanctify your holy name. All flesh will praise and bless your name beyond its strength, forever and ever.

For the mercy of the Lord of Spirits is great, and he is slow to anger. All his works and all his power, in accordance with what he has done, he has revealed to the righteous and the chosen in the name of the Lord of Spirits.
Thus the Lord commanded the kings, the mighty, the exalted, the powerful, and those who dwell on the earth, saying, “Open your eyes and lift up your horns, if you can recognize the Chosen One.”

The Lord of Spirits sat on the throne of his glory, and the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him. The word of his mouth will kill all sinners and all the wicked, and they will perish before his face.

On that day all the kings, the mighty, the exalted, and those who possess the earth will stand. They will see him and recognize that he sits on the throne of his glory, that the righteous are judged before him in righteousness, and that no false word is spoken before him.
Pain will come upon them as upon a woman in labor, whom childbirth torments when her child reaches the opening of her womb and she suffers in childbirth.
They will look at one another and be terrified, and they will lower their faces. Pain will seize them when they see that Son of Woman sitting on the throne of his glory.
The kings, the mighty, and all those who possess the earth will praise, bless, and exalt him who rules over everything hidden.
For the Son of Man was hidden from the beginning, and the Most High kept him in the presence of his power and revealed him to the chosen ones.
The assembly of the holy and the chosen will be sown, and all the chosen will stand before him on that day.
All the kings, the mighty, the exalted, and those who rule the dry land will fall on their faces and bow down. They will set their hope on that Son of Man, plead with him, and ask him for mercy.
Then the Lord of Spirits will drive them away, so that they hurry out from before his face. Their faces will be filled with shame, and darkness will deepen upon their faces.
He will hand them over to the angels of punishment, so that they may exact payment from them for the oppression they inflicted on his children and his chosen ones.

They will become an example to his chosen ones, and his righteous ones will rejoice over them, because the wrath of the Lord of Spirits rests upon them, and the scourge of the Lord of Spirits becomes drunk from them.
The righteous and the chosen will be saved on that day, and from then on they will no longer see the faces of sinners and the wicked.
The Lord of Spirits will rest upon them, and they will dwell with that Son of Man. They will eat and drink, lie down and rise, forever and ever.
The righteous and the chosen rose from the earth, stopped lowering their faces, and put on the garment of life.
This will be the garment of life in the presence of the Lord of Spirits. Your garments will not wear out, and your glory will not come to an end before the Lord of Spirits.

And in those days the mighty kings who possess the earth will plead with the angels of his punishment, to whom they have been handed over, to give them a little rest, so that they may fall down and worship before the Lord of Spirits and confess their sins before him.

They will bless and praise the Lord of Spirits and say, “Blessed is the Lord, the Lord of Spirits and the Lord of kings, the Lord of the mighty, the Lord of the wealthy, the Lord of glory, and the Lord of wisdom. Through him everything hidden is brought to light.”
“Your power is from generation to generation, and your glory is forever and ever. All your hidden things are deep and beyond counting, and your righteousness is beyond reckoning.”
“Now we have learned that we should praise and bless the Lord of kings, who reigns over all kings.”
They said, “Who would grant us rest, so that we might praise him, thank him, bless him, and believe in his glory?”
“Even now we long for a little rest, but we do not find it. We pursue it, but we do not grasp it. Light has passed away from before us, and darkness is our dwelling forever and ever.”

For we did not believe before him, nor did we give praise in the name of the Lord of kings, nor did we praise the Lord for all his works. Our hope rested on the scepter of our royal throne and on our glory.

On the day of our toil and distress, he does not save us, and we find no rest. We believe that our Lord is faithful in all his works, in all his judgments, and in his righteousness, and that his judgments show no partiality.
We pass away from his presence because of our deeds, and all our sins have been counted with justice.
And now they will say to them, “Our soul is filled with wealth gained through wrongdoing, but it does not prevent our descent into the flame in the depths of Sheol.”
After this, darkness and shame will fill their faces before that Son of Man. They will be driven from his presence, and a sword will remain among them before him.
Thus the Lord of Spirits said: “This is the decree and judgment concerning the mighty, the kings, the exalted, and those who possess the earth, before the Lord of Spirits.”
I saw other figures hidden in that place.
I heard the voice of the angel saying, “These are the angels who came down from heaven to earth, revealed hidden things to human beings, and led human beings astray so that they committed sin.”
In those days Noah saw that the earth had tilted and that its destruction was near.
He set out from there and went to the ends of the earth. He cried out to his grandfather Enoch, and Noah said in a bitter voice, “Hear me! Hear me! Hear me!” three times.
He said to him, “Tell me what is happening on the earth, for the earth is suffering and shaking like this. Perhaps I will perish with it.”
After that, there was a great disturbance on the earth, and a voice was heard from heaven, and [?] fell on my face.
And Enoch came from [?] and stood beside me and said to me, “Why have you cried out to me with a bitter cry and weeping?”

A command went out from the presence of the Lord of Spirits against those who dwell on the dry land, that this should be their destruction, because they had learned all the secrets of the angels, all the violence of the satans, all the hidden power of those who practice sorcery, the power of enchantments, and the power of those who cast molten images throughout the earth.
They had even learned how silver is produced from the dust of the earth and how molten metal comes to be on the earth.
For lead and tin are not produced from the earth like the first metal. A spring produces them, and an angel stands within it, and that angel takes precedence.
After this, my grandfather Enoch took hold of me with his hand, raised me up, and said to me, “Go, for I have asked the Lord of Spirits about this disturbance on the earth.”

He said to me, “Because of their wrongdoing, their judgment has been settled, and they will not be counted before me because of the months they investigated. They have learned that the earth and those who dwell upon it will be destroyed.”

“For these there is no return forever, because they revealed hidden things to them and are among those who have been condemned. But this is not for you, my son. The Lord of Spirits knows that you are pure and good, free from this hidden guilt.”

And he will establish your name among the holy ones and preserve you among those who dwell on dry land. He will establish your descendants in righteousness for kingship and great glory. From your descendants will come a fountain of righteous and holy people, and they will be countless forever.

After this, he showed me the angels of punishment, who were ready to come and release all the power of the water beneath the earth, so that it would bring judgment and destruction upon all who live and dwell on the dry land.
The Lord of Spirits commanded the angels who were going out not to raise their hands, but to hold back, for those angels were in charge of the power of the waters.
I left Enoch’s presence.
In those days the word of God came to me, and he said to me, “Noah, look, your portion has come up before me, a portion without guilt, a portion of love and uprightness.”

“Now the angels are working on the timbers. When they set out on that task, I will place my hand upon it and preserve it. From it will come the seed of life, and a new generation will come, so that the dry land will not remain bare.”

“I will establish your descendants before me forever and ever. I will plant those who dwell with you on the face of the dry land, and they will multiply and be blessed upon the dry land in the name of the Lord of Spirits.”

They will imprison those angels who revealed wrongdoing in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch previously showed me in the west, near the mountains of gold, silver, iron, molten metal, and tin.
