Woe to you who acquire silver and gold unrighteously and say, “We have become wealthy, we have possessions, and we have acquired everything we wanted.”
And now let us do what we have planned, for we have gathered silver and filled our storehouses, and the cultivators of our estates are as abundant as water.

Your lies will flow away like water, for your wealth will not remain with you but will soon depart from you, because you acquired it all through injustice. You yourselves will be handed over to a great curse.
And now I swear to you, the wise and the foolish, that you will see much upon the earth.
For you men adorn yourselves more than women, and with colorful clothing more than a virgin, in [?], in kingship, greatness, power, silver, gold, clothing, honor, and food that flows like water.

Because of this they have no instruction or wisdom, and through it they will be destroyed together with their possessions and all their glory and honor. In shame, poverty, slaughter, and great destitution, their spirits will be thrown into a furnace of fire.

I swear to you sinners: just as no mountain has become a slave or ever will, nor a rock a woman's servant, so sin was not sent upon the earth. Rather, human beings created it themselves, and those who commit it will come under a great curse.
Barrenness was not imposed upon a woman; rather, because of the work of her own hands she dies without children.
I swear to you sinners by the Holy and Great One that all your evil deeds are revealed in heaven, and none of your acts of violence is concealed or hidden.
Do not suppose in your spirits or say in your hearts that you do not know and do not see: all your sin is being written in heaven every day before the Most High.
From now on, know that every act of violence you commit is written down every day until the day of your judgment.
Woe to you fools, for you will be destroyed through your foolishness! You do not listen to the wise, and good will not come to you.

And now know that you are ready for the day of destruction. Do not hope that you will live, you sinners; rather, you will depart and die, for you know no ransom. You have been made ready for the day of great judgment and for the day of distress and great disgrace for your spirits.

Woe to you hardhearted people who do evil and consume blood! From where do you have good things to eat, and eat and drink and become full? For all the good things that our Lord, the Most High, has made abundant upon the earth, you have no peace.

Woe to you who love acts of injustice! Why do you hope for good for yourselves? Know that you are to be handed over into the hands of the righteous. They will cut your necks and kill you, and they will not show you mercy.
Woe to you who rejoice in the distress of the righteous, for no grave will be dug for you!
Woe to you who make the words of the righteous worthless, for you will have no hope of life!

Woe to you who write lying words and the words of the wicked! They write their lies so that others may hear them and not forget their foolishness. They will have no peace, but will surely die and will not [?].
Woe to you who practice wickedness and to those who praise and honor falsehood! You will perish, and you will have neither life nor anything good.
Woe to you who distort truthful words, transgress the eternal law, and turn yourselves into what you were not—sinners! You will be trampled on the earth.

In those days, prepare yourselves, righteous ones, to raise your prayers as a memorial. Present them as testimony before the angels, so that they may place the sin of sinners before the Most High as a memorial.
In those days the nations will be thrown into turmoil, and the families of the nations will rise up on the day of destruction.

In those days those who are pregnant will go out and tear out their children. They will abandon their children, and their offspring will fall from them. They will abandon them while they are nursing and will not return to them or have mercy on their beloved children.
Again I swear to you sinners that sin has been prepared for a day of bloodshed that will not cease.

They worship stone, and those who carve images of gold, silver, wood, and clay, and those who worship unclean spirits, evil demons, every idol, and forbidden things—no help at all will be found from them.
They will become wicked through the madness of their hearts, and their eyes will grow dim through the fear in their hearts and the visions of their dreams.
Through these things they will become wicked and afraid, because they have done all their deeds in falsehood and worshiped stone. They will perish together.

In those days, blessed are all who receive the word of wisdom, understand it, follow the ways of the Most High, and walk on the path of righteousness. They will not become wicked with those who become wicked, for they will be saved.
Woe to you who spread evil against your neighbors, for you will be killed in Sheol!
Woe to you who lay the foundation of sin and deceit and cause bitterness on the earth, for in it they will come to an end!
Woe to you who build your houses with the labor of others, whose building materials are all bricks and stones of sin! I tell you that you will have no peace.
Woe to those who reject the dwelling and eternal inheritance of their ancestors and lead their souls after idols, for they will have no rest!
Woe to you who practice injustice, support oppression, and kill your neighbors until the day of the great judgment!
He will bring down your glory, put evil into your hearts, and raise the spirit of his wrath to destroy you all with the sword. All the righteous and holy will remember your sin.
In those days, in one place, fathers and their children will strike one another, and brothers will fall dead with their companions, until their blood flows like a river.

For a man will not mercifully restrain his hand from killing his son or his grandson, and a sinner will not restrain his hand against his honored brother. From dawn until sunset they will kill one another.
A horse will walk through the blood of sinners up to its back, and a chariot will sink up to its top.
In those days angels will descend into the hiding places and gather into one place all those who support sin. On that day the Most High will rise to carry out a great judgment against all sinners.

He will appoint guards from among the holy angels over all the righteous and holy ones, and they will guard them like the pupil of an eye until all evil and all sin come to an end. Even if the righteous sleep, they will sleep a long sleep, and they will have nothing to fear.
The wise will truly see, and the children of the earth will understand all the words of this book. They will know that their wealth cannot save them when their sins bring them down.
Woe to you sinners when you afflict the righteous on the day of severe anguish and burn them with fire! You will be repaid according to your deeds.
Woe to you, hardhearted ones, who stay watchful to devise evil! Fear will overtake you, and there will be no one to help you.
Woe to you sinners! Because of the words of your mouths and the deeds of your hands, which are your wicked acts, you will burn in the heat of blazing fire.
Now know that your deeds will be investigated in heaven by the angels, the sun, the moon, and the stars because of your sins, for on earth you inflict punishment on the righteous.
He will make every cloud, mist, dew, and rain testify against you, for they are all being withheld from you so that they do not descend upon you, and they will not take your sins into account.

Now give a gift to the rain so that it will not be withheld from falling upon you. And if the dew has been given gold and silver by you so that it may descend, when frost and snow and their cold fall from you [?], and all the winds of snow and all their afflictions come, in those days you will not be able to stand before them.
Examine heaven, all you children of heaven, and all the work of the Most High. Fear him, and do not do evil before him.
If he closes the windows of heaven and holds back the rain and dew so that they do not fall on the earth because of you, what will you do?
And if he sends his wrath upon you and upon all your deeds, will you not plead with him? For you speak great and harsh words against his righteousness, and you have no peace.
Do you not see those who command ships, who are tossed about by the waves, whose ships are shaken by the winds, and who are distressed?
They are afraid because all their valuable possessions go out to sea with them. They expect nothing good in their hearts, because the sea will swallow them and they will perish in it.
Are not the whole sea, all its waters, and all its movements the work of the Most High? He made it all, sealed its waters, and enclosed it on every side with sand.
At his rebuke it dries up and is afraid, and all its fish die, along with everything in it. But you sinners on the earth do not fear him.
Did he not make heaven and earth and everything in them? And who gave knowledge and wisdom to all those who move about on the earth and to those in the sea?
Do not those who command ships fear the sea? Yet sinners do not fear the Most High.
In those days, if he casts terrifying fire upon you, where will you flee, and where will you find safety? And when he directs his voice against you, will you not tremble and be afraid?
All the heavenly lights will tremble and be shaken with great fear. The whole earth will tremble with great fear, quake, and convulse.

All the angels will carry out their commands and will wish to hide from the great glory. The children of the earth will tremble and be shaken. But you sinners are cursed forever, and you have no peace.
Do not be afraid, you souls of the righteous. Have hope, you who have died in righteousness.

Do not grieve because your souls descended into great distress, crying and groaning, and into Sheol in sorrow, and because during your lifetime your bodies did not receive what your goodness deserved, but instead [?] on the day when you became sinners, and on the day of curse and punishment.
When you die, sinners will say about you, “The righteous died just as we die. What benefit did their deeds bring them?
Look, they died like us, in sorrow and darkness. How are they better off than we are? From now on we are equal.
What will they receive, and what will they see forever? Look, they too have died, and from now on they will never see light.”
I tell you, you sinners: you have had enough eating and drinking, violence and sin, stripping people of their possessions, acquiring wealth, and seeing good days.
Have you seen the righteous, how their end was peaceful, because no oppression was found against them until the day of their death?
They perished and became as though they had never existed, and their souls descended into Sheol in distress.
And now I swear to you, the righteous, by his great glory and honor, by his glorious kingdom and by his greatness—I swear to you.
For I know this mystery. I have read the tablets of heaven and seen the writings of the holy ones, and I found written and engraved in them concerning them:

All goodness, joy, and honor have been prepared for them and written down for the spirits of those who died in righteousness and uprightness. Abundant goodness will be given to you in compensation for your labor, and your portion will be greater than the portion of the living.

Your spirits will live, you who died in righteousness. Their spirits and their remembrance will rejoice and be glad before the Great One for all generations forever. And now do not fear their disgrace.
Woe to you sinners when you die in your sins, and those like you say about you, “Blessed are the sinners! They have seen all their days.”
And now they died in prosperity and wealth, and they saw no distress or slaughter during their lives. They died in honor, and no judgment was carried out against them during their lives.
Do you not know that their souls will be brought down into Sheol, and that their distress will be great and terrible?
Your spirits will enter darkness, nets, and a burning flame, where there is great judgment. This great judgment will last for all generations forever. Woe to you, for you have no peace!

Do not say to the righteous and good who are alive, “In the days of our labor we have toiled painfully, seen every hardship, and encountered many evils. We have been brought to an end and reduced in number, and our spirit has grown weak.”
We were destroyed, and there was no one to help us. We lacked help in word and deed, and we found nothing. We were tormented and destroyed, and we had no hope of living from one day to the next.

We hoped to become the head, but we became the tail. We toiled as we worked, but we had no control over the fruits of our labor. They became food for sinners, and the unjust laid their heavy yoke upon us.
Those who hated us and struck us ruled over us. We bowed our necks to those who hated us, and they showed us no mercy.
We wanted to leave them so that we could escape and rest, but we found nowhere to flee and be safe from them.
In our distress we complained about them to the angels, and we cried out against those who devoured us. But they did not acknowledge our cries and did not want to hear our voice.

They helped those who oppressed and devoured us, and those who diminished our numbers. They concealed their wrongdoing and did not remove from us the yokes of those who devoured us, scattered us, and killed us. They concealed our slaughter and did not remember that they had raised their hands against us.
I swear to you, righteous ones, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One, and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
Have hope! Formerly you were disgraced through suffering and hardship, but now you will shine like the light of heaven and will be seen, and the gates of heaven will be opened to you.
With your cries, cry out for judgment, and it will appear to you, for an accounting of all your distress will be demanded from the angels and from all those who helped your oppressors.
Have hope, and do not abandon your hope, for you will have great joy, like the angels in heaven.
What you must do is [?]. You will not have to hide on the day of great judgment, and you will not be found like sinners. Eternal judgment will be away from you for all the generations of eternity.

And now, righteous ones, do not be afraid when you see sinners growing strong and prospering as they desire. Do not become their companions, but keep far away from their wrongdoing, for you are to become companions of the host of heaven.
For you sinners say, “None of our sins will be investigated or written down.” But all your sins are being written down every day.
And now I show you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.

Do not act wickedly in your hearts, do not lie, do not distort the word of truth, and do not falsify the word of the Holy and Great One. Do not praise your idols, for all your lies and all your wickedness lead not to righteousness but to great sin.
And now I know this mystery: many sinners will distort and alter the word of truth. They will speak evil words, lie, invent great fabrications, and write books containing their words.
But when they write all my words correctly in their languages, neither changing nor diminishing any of my words, but writing everything correctly—all that I first proclaimed concerning them—
I know another mystery: books will be given to the righteous and the wise for joy, truth, and abundant wisdom.
Books will be given to them, and they will believe in them and rejoice in them. All the righteous who have learned from them all the paths of truth will be glad.
And in those days the Lord said that they should call out and make themselves heard to humanity in their wisdom: “Show them that you are their guides, and [?] rewards over all the earth.
For I and my son will be united with them forever in the paths of truth during their lives. You will have peace. Rejoice, children of truth, truly!”
After some time, my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech. She conceived by him and gave birth to a son.

His flesh was white like snow and red like a rose. The hair of his head and his locks were like white wool, and his eyes were beautiful. When he opened his eyes, he lit up the whole house like the sun, and the entire house shone even more brightly.
And when he rose from the midwife’s hands, he opened his mouth and spoke praise to the Lord of righteousness.
His father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and he came to his father Methuselah.

He said to him, “I have fathered an unusual son. He is not like a human being, but resembles the children of the angels of heaven. His nature is different, and he is not like us. His eyes are like the rays of the sun, and his face is radiant.”
“It seems to me that he is not from me, but from the angels, and I am afraid that something extraordinary may happen on earth in his days.”
“And now, my father, I am here to plead with you and ask you to go to our father Enoch and hear the truth from him, for he lives with the angels.”

When Methuselah heard what his son said, he came to me at the ends of the earth, for he had heard that I was there. He cried out, and I heard his voice. I came to him and said, “Here I am, my son, since you have come to me.”
He answered me and said, “I have come to you about a great matter and because of an astonishing sight that I have encountered.”

“And now, my father, listen to me. A son has been born to my son Lamech who does not resemble him. His form is like the form of a human being, but his complexion is whiter than snow and redder than a rose. The hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun. When he opened his eyes, he lit up the whole house.”
“He rose from the midwife’s hands, opened his mouth, and blessed the Lord of heaven.”

“His father Lamech, my son, was afraid and fled to me. He does not believe that the child is from him; rather, he resembles the angels of heaven. He said to me, ‘Here I have come to you so that you may tell me the truth.’”

I, Enoch, answered concerning him and said to him, “The Lord will bring about new things on earth and will act. And this [?] I went out and saw in a vision, and I made it known to you, for the household of the son of Jared, my father, [?] transgressed the word of the Lord from the height of heaven.”
And they commit sin and transgress the established order. They have joined themselves to women and commit sin with them. They have taken wives from among them and fathered children by them.
Great destruction will come upon the whole earth, and there will be a flood. Great destruction will take place in a single year.
This is the son who has been born to you. He will remain on earth, and his three sons will be saved with him. When all the people on earth die, he and his sons will be saved.
They will father offspring on earth who grow large, not of spirit but of flesh. A great punishment will come upon the earth, and the earth will be washed clean of all corruption.

And now, tell your son Lamech that the child who has been born is truly his son. Call his name Noah, for he will be a survivor for you. He and his children will be saved from the destruction that will come upon the earth because of all the sin and all the wrongdoing that will be committed on earth in his days.

After this, there will be wrongdoing greater than what was previously committed on earth. For I know the mysteries of the holy ones, because the Lord himself has shown them to me and made them known to me, and I have read them on the tablets of heaven and understood them.

I saw written on them that each generation will become worse than the one before it, until a righteous generation arises. Then wrongdoing will be destroyed, sin will be wiped from the earth, and every good thing will come upon it.
And now, my son, go and tell your son Lamech that this child who has been born is truly his own son, and this is no lie.

When Methuselah heard the words of his father Enoch, who had shown him everything in secret, he returned and saw him. He named that child Noah, for he would bring joy to the earth after all the destruction.
Another book that Enoch wrote for his son Methuselah and for those who would come after him and keep the established order in the last days.
Which you have committed. You will remain during these days until those who do evil come to an end and the power of the sinners comes to an end.

But you must wait until sin passes away, for their names will be erased from the books of the holy ones, and their descendants will be destroyed forever. Their spirits will be killed, and they will cry out and wail in a desolate, invisible place. They will burn in fire, for there is no earth there.

There I saw something like a cloud that could not be clearly seen, for because of its depth I could not look over it. I saw a bright flame of fire burning, and things circled like shining mountains and were tossed about to and fro.

I asked one of the holy angels who were with me and said to him, “What is this shining thing? It is not heaven, but only a burning flame of fire, with the sound of cries, weeping, wailing, and severe suffering.”

He said to me, “This place that you see is where the spirits of sinners and the condemned will be placed, along with those who commit sin and those who distort everything that God has spoken through the mouths of his prophets who are active on earth.”

For some of these things are written and inscribed above in heaven, so that the angels may read them and know what will happen to sinners, to humble spirits, to those who have afflicted their bodies and received their recompense from God, and to those who have been humiliated by wicked people.
These are those who love God and love neither gold nor silver nor any of the good things in the world, who have given their bodies over to suffering.

From the time they came into being, they did not desire earthly food, but regarded themselves as a passing wind, and they held to this. The Lord tested them greatly, and their spirits were found pure, so that they might bless his name.

I have told in the books all their blessings and the reward that is theirs, for they were found to love heaven more than their life in the world. Though they were trampled by wicked people, heard reproach and insults from them, and were humiliated, they continued to bless me.

And now I will summon the spirits of the good from the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness, who in their flesh were not rewarded with the honor their faith deserved.
And I will bring out into shining light those who love my holy name, and I will seat each one on his throne of honor.
And they will shine for ages beyond number, because God's judgment is righteous, for he will grant faithfulness to the faithful in the dwelling of upright paths.
And they will see those who were born in darkness cast into darkness, while the righteous shine.
And the sinners will cry out and see them shining, and they too will go where days and seasons have been prescribed for them.
